items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: I only used the James Belloc.

ctx.x: Can you remember anything about your lessons with Professor Renetta? Did he, what books or anything else he might have used or how he taught you? So I see I've gone to some of his lessons on the clarinet and also a friend of mine that took a few piano lessons once, a boy from Chicago. And do I know something about his teaching? I just wondered in those days back then.
I only used the James Belloc.
James, I'm not even familiar with that.
